rules.name: High CPU
rules.description: CPU is above 50 % of the available CPU for two samples in a row (about 2 to 4 seconds). The Chaos Lab CPU spike triggers it.

rules.name: Memory above baseline
rules.description: Resident memory is more than 30 MB above the learned baseline for three samples in a row. The Chaos Lab memory leak triggers it.

rules.name: Watchdog flagging samples
rules.description: The watchdog (baseline check plus Isolation Forest) has flagged two samples in a row as anomalous, which is also when it opens an incident.

rules.name: Database unhealthy
rules.description: The database fails its integrity check. The Chaos Lab database corruption triggers it; restoring a snapshot resolves it.
